title: Interactive Developer Portfolio & Resume Builder
summary: Build a responsive, themed personal portfolio website featuring dark/light mode toggle, dynamic project showcases, contact forms, and animated skill meters.
deliverables: Responsive layout optimized for mobile and desktop viewports
Dynamic dark/light theme switcher with localStorage persistence
Filterable project grid with modal previews and live demo links
Contact form with client-side validation and toast notifications

title: Kanban Task Management Board (TaskFlow)
summary: Build a full-featured Trello-style Kanban board allowing users to create columns, drag and drop tasks, set priorities, filter by tag, and save state locally.
deliverables: Drag-and-drop interface for moving task cards across status columns
Task creation modal with title, description, due date, and priority labels
Subtask progress bar and comment thread preview
State management using Zustand or React Context with local storage backup

title: E-Commerce REST API & Auth Engine
summary: Design a secure RESTful API powering an online store with JWT authentication, role-based access control (Admin/Customer), product search, shopping cart, and Redis rate limiting.
deliverables: User authentication endpoints (register, login, refresh token, password hash with bcrypt)
Role-based authorization middleware protecting Admin routes
Product catalog with pagination, category filter, and text search
Redis integration for API rate-limiting and query caching

title: Full-Stack AI Code Review Assistant (SaaS)
summary: Develop a multi-tenant web application where developers paste code snippets or connect GitHub repos to receive automated AI code reviews, security vulnerability scans, and refactoring tips.
deliverables: Next.js App Router with Server Actions and API routes
Database schema for user accounts, code snippets, and analysis reports
Integration with LLM APIs for automated code review and security auditing
Syntax-highlighted diff viewer comparing original vs suggested code

title: Document QA Bot using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
summary: Build an intelligent document reader where users upload PDF/TXT documents, which are chunked, embedded into a vector database, and queried using conversational AI.
deliverables: Document ingestion pipeline with text splitting and vector embedding generation
Vector store setup with semantic similarity search
RAG chain combining retrieved context with LLM response generation
Interactive Streamlit UI for uploading files and chatting with documents

title: Real-Time Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Detection
summary: Train a custom computer vision model to detect whether industrial workers are wearing safety helmets, vests, and masks in real-time camera streams.
deliverables: Custom dataset annotation and augmentation pipeline
YOLOv8 fine-tuning on safety gear detection classes
Real-time video feed processor with bounding boxes and alert overlays
Gradio web dashboard showing live detection metrics and breach logs

title: GitOps Automated CI/CD Pipeline with Kubernetes
summary: Architect an enterprise-grade DevOps workflow that automatically tests microservices on git push, builds Docker containers, and deploys them to a Minikube/EKS Kubernetes cluster using ArgoCD.
deliverables: Dockerfile optimization with multi-stage builds for minimal container sizes
GitHub Actions workflow for automated unit tests and Docker Hub pushing
Helm charts defining Deployment, Service, Ingress, and HPA resources
ArgoCD setup for declarative GitOps sync and Prometheus monitoring dashboard

title: Multi-Tier Cloud Infrastructure Automation with Terraform
summary: Write modular Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision a secure VPC with public/private subnets, auto-scaling web servers, RDS PostgreSQL, and S3 bucket policies on AWS.
deliverables: Modular Terraform files for VPC, Subnets, Internet Gateway, and Route Tables
Auto-Scaling Group (ASG) behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB)
Secure RDS database instance inside private subnets with secret manager integration
Terraform state locking using S3 and DynamoDB

title: Cross-Platform Fitness & Workout Tracker App
summary: Create a modern iOS and Android app for tracking daily workouts, caloric intake, step counters, and custom exercise routines with progress charts.
deliverables: Clean UI built with Flutter material/cupertino widgets and custom animations
Firebase Authentication (Email & Google sign-in)
Offline-first sync using Hive local DB and Firestore Cloud backup
Interactive analytics charts tracking monthly exercise consistency

title: Native Android Weather & Radar App (Compose)
summary: Develop a native Android app using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose that fetches live weather forecasts based on GPS location and renders dynamic weather animations.
deliverables: Declarative UI screens with Jetpack Compose and custom state hoisting
REST API integration via Retrofit and Kotlin Coroutines/Flow
Device location services permission handling and geocoding
Hourly/7-day forecast views with condition-based background gradients

title: Home Security Operations Center (SOC) & SIEM Lab
summary: Set up a virtualized SOC home lab using Wazuh SIEM to monitor Windows/Linux endpoints, detect simulated malware attacks, and generate automated incident response alerts.
deliverables: Virtual network lab setup with isolated Attacker, Victim, and SIEM nodes
Endpoint agent configuration with Sysmon logging rules
Simulated brute-force and credential dumping attack scenarios
Custom SIEM dashboards and email notification alerts for critical security events

title: Automated Web Vulnerability & Header Scanner
summary: Write a security audit tool in Python that scans target web applications for missing HTTP security headers, CORS misconfigurations, open directories, and SQL injection flaws.
deliverables: HTTP response header analyzer checking for HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, and XSS protection
CORS misconfiguration detector checking wildcard origins
Basic SQLi and Reflected XSS payload test engine for form fields
HTML summary report generation highlighting risk severity (High/Med/Low)

title: Automated Crypto & Stock Data Pipeline with Apache Airflow
summary: Build an ETL data pipeline orchestrated by Apache Airflow that extracts daily market data, cleans and normalizes records, loads into PostgreSQL, and exposes a BI dashboard in Metabase.
deliverables: Airflow DAG setup with scheduled hourly extraction tasks and error retries
Data cleaning and schema validation module using Pandas
Relational star-schema data warehouse models in PostgreSQL
Interactive Metabase dashboard showcasing moving averages and volume trends

title: Predictive Customer Churn Analytics Platform
summary: Perform exploratory data analysis and train machine learning models (Random Forest, XGBoost) to predict telecom subscriber churn, identifying key churn drivers and business recommendations.
deliverables: Comprehensive EDA notebook with correlation heatmaps and feature distributions
Feature engineering including categorical encoding and feature scaling
Model comparison matrix (ROC-AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-score)
Actionable executive summary report detailing high-risk customer segments
